mintAuthority.summary: GBPA has five issuer-native deployments. Ethereum, Base and Arc retain a direct EOA fiat minter and an EOA owner of the upgrade administration. Solana minting uses a 1-of-2 Token-2022 multisig, allowing either signer to authorize issuance. Tempo native issuance roles remain undisclosed. LayerZero source-burn/destination-credit machinery is authored separately under Bridge Risk.

controls.evidence: Fresh pinned reads at Ethereum block 26107703, Base 52095851, Arc 23952287 return hasMintRole=true for this address and eth_getCode=0x on all three chains. The verified Ethereum/Base implementation permits role-controlled minting without a reserve oracle or fixed numeric issuance cap. Arc uses a different implementation, retained explicitly; complete role and cap inventories are not claimed.

Current implementations resolve to 0x4b55cc51901ef212a6cb4fa5e5daa6575afdd3f0 on Ethereum/Base and 0x302a8a24e79c4f987cb7dd4993a8c998079784b1 on Arc. The native mint-logic replacement path is controlled here; bridge peer/configuration powers are recorded separately.

controls.label: GBPA Solana native mint multisig
controls.evidence: At finalized slot 452748382, the native Token-2022 mint and initialized mint-authority multisig decode as 1 required signature from 2 valid signers: 2Z1jwnD78v1q4Nt6suH5YkgskqRgNySdbPbdYWcYxug4 and AkRcEoab3ECQ4GoDgVb9jE9wVMVeSksR3TwGCmdNEtB8. The second signer is also the mint permanent delegate. A 1-of-2 threshold is not two-person approval and issuer Fireblocks policy does not upgrade this on-chain quorum.

review.evidence: Fresh EVM control reads at Ethereum block 26107703, Base 52095851, Arc 23952287 and finalized Solana slot 452748382 corroborate concentrated native issuance authority. The September 30 Nephos report periodically reconciles GBP 1,904,014.09 reserve balances against 1,900,346.94 GBPA across all five networks; the issuer describes regular reserve attestations. Its contradictory assurance-method language is capped at attestation and does not establish prudential issuer supervision. Token supply can be originated outside the supply-conserving LayerZero path. The authority inventory is deliberately partial, with Tempo roles and exhaustive EVM minter/admin membership not established.
